identity: For each parent polynomial g_j=G_j/d_j, solve sum(mu_j*m_j*G_j)=rhs over Q with integer matrix columns; export lambda_j=d_j*mu_j. This is an invertible nonzero constant column scaling and leaves the ideal identity unchanged.
motivation: Direct rational matrices can form large row denominator LCMs across many differently normalized parent polynomials. Clear denominators columnwise before the multi-RHS solve.
proof_checks: All individual rational polynomial identities and terminal constant are still replayed exactly.
